heading.en: Three Different Things Get Called “SABS Requirements”

body.en:
A buyer in South Africa asks for "SABS compliant" fasteners, and the phrase usually means one of three different things without saying which. The first is a technical standard: the national standard that describes the product, its dimensions, its properties and its test methods. The second is a certification scheme: a voluntary mark that a manufacturer can obtain for a product range, involving testing and factory assessment. The third is a compulsory specification: a regulation that makes a product's conformity a legal condition of sale in certain categories.

The three have different consequences. A standard tells you what the product should be, and a supplier can meet it without any certificate at all. A mark scheme tells you that an independent body has assessed the manufacturer's capability for that range. A compulsory specification tells you that selling without conformity is unlawful, which is a matter for the importer rather than for the factory.

Most confusion comes from using the word "certified" for all three. A mill certificate is a statement about a batch of steel. A test report is a statement about a sample. A mark licence is a statement about a production system. None of them substitutes for the others, and the paperwork a buyer asks for should say which of the three is actually required.

The practical reason this matters is that each one is obtained by a different route, costs a different amount of time, and imposes a different obligation on the buyer. Asking for the wrong one either inflates the price or leaves the delivery non-compliant, and in both cases the buyer finds out late.

So the first step in any South African enquiry is to write down, in one line, which of the three the project actually needs. Most consumer and structural fasteners need the standard and the documents; a smaller set of categories need the compulsory conformity; the mark is usually a marketing or tender requirement rather than a legal one.
body.zh:
南非买方张口就要「符合 SABS」的紧固件，这句话其实同时装着三件不同的事，却没说哪一件。第一件是技术标准：描述产品、尺寸、性能、试验方法的国家标准。第二件是认证标志：制造厂可以为一个产品系列申请的自愿性标志，要测样、还要审厂。第三件是强制规范：在某些品类里，产品符合性成为合法销售前提的法规。

三件事的后果完全不同。标准告诉你产品应该是什么样，供应商可以完全没有任何证书就满足它；标志告诉你，有独立机构评估过这家厂在这个系列上的能力；强制规范告诉你，不合规销售是违法的——这是进口商的责任，不是工厂的责任。

混淆大多来自一个词：都把三种东西叫「认证」。材质书是关于一批钢的陈述，试验报告是关于一个样品的陈述，标志许可是关于一个生产体系的陈述。三者互不替代，而买方要的文件应当说清是哪一种。

实际操作上所以要紧，是因为三者的获取路径不同、耗时不同、对买方的义务也不同。要错了那一种，要么把价格抬上去，要么让到货本身不合规，而两种情况买方都是很晚才知道。

所以每一次南非询价的第一步，是用一句话写下这项工程真正需要三者中的哪一个。多数通用与结构紧固件要的是标准加文件；少数品类要强制性符合；标志通常是投标或渠道的要求，而不是法定要求。

body.en:
South African fastener standards follow the international body of practice rather than inventing a separate one, which is good news for an importer: a product made to an international standard is usually describable in the national vocabulary without redesign. The national standard family for fasteners covers the same product groups — bolts, screws, nuts, washers — with dimensional and property requirements laid out per part.

The important qualification is that a national standard is an adoption with its own edition and its own national annexes. When a project specifies a standard edition, it means that edition; a product made to a later or earlier edition may comply in substance and fail in documentation.

Where customers name a designation that does not look like a standard at all — a company specification, an older national designation, a tender clause — the right move is to ask for the edition and the scope rather than to substitute an international standard that seems equivalent. Substituting an equivalent is the fastest way to be technically right and formally rejected.

For the buyer, the useful output of this section is a table with three columns: the product, the standard reference named by the customer, and the property that the customer's acceptance actually depends on. The third column is what the inspection should test; the first two are what the paperwork should cite.

Where no standard is named, the honest approach is to propose one: the international standard for the product, plus the coating standard for the finish, and state both in the offer. A proposal that names its references can be checked; an offer that says "international standard" cannot.
body.zh:
南非的紧固件标准是跟着国际实践走的，不是另起一套，这对进口商是好消息：按国际标准做出来的产品，通常不用重新设计就能用当地标准的语汇说清楚。紧固件的国家标准族覆盖同样的产品组——螺栓、螺钉、螺母、垫圈——按件分列尺寸与性能要求。

要紧的限定是：国家标准是一种「采用」，有自己的版本号和国家附录。工程写明了版本，指的就是那一个版本；按更早或更晚版本做的产品，可能在实质上合格，却在文件上不合格。

客户提到的编号如果根本不像标准——公司规范、旧的国家牌号、招标条款——正确的做法是问清版本和适用范围，而不是拿一个看起来等效的国际标准去替代。用「等效」去做替代，是最快做到「技术上正确、形式上被拒」的办法。

对买方有用的产出，是一张三列的表格：产品、客户指定的标准引用、以及客户验收真正依赖的那个性能。第三列决定检验测什么，前两列决定文件引什么。

如果客户没点名任何标准，诚实的做法是自己提一个：该产品的国际标准，加上表面处理的镀层标准，并在报价里明写。写明引用的方案可以被核对；只写「国际标准」的报价不能被核对。

body.en:
The mark is a licence to use a symbol, granted after an assessment of the manufacturer's quality system and of the product against the standard. It is voluntary in the sense that it is not required by law for most fastener categories, and it is not voluntary in the sense that a tender may require it, a retailer may insist on it, and a failure to have it can cost a contract.

What the mark actually certifies is capability and consistency: that the factory can make the product to the standard and that its system controls the routine. It does not certify a batch. A marked product still needs its batch certificate to be traceable, and a marked factory can still ship a wrong batch.

The route to a mark runs through an application, testing of samples, an assessment of the production facility, and ongoing surveillance. For an importer buying from an overseas factory, this is a factory decision rather than a purchasing decision: it takes months, it involves audits, and it is not something a purchase order can create.

That gives the buyer a clear question to ask: does the project require the mark, or does it require conformity to the standard with batch documentation? If it requires the mark, the supplier list narrows sharply and the price reflects it. If it requires conformity, the supplier list is broad and the inspection plan does the work.

Where a customer insists on the mark and the supplier does not hold it, the honest answer is to say so and to offer the alternative evidence — batch certificates, test reports, third-party pre-shipment inspection — rather than to imply a certification that does not exist. A claim of certification that cannot be produced at the port is worse than no claim at all.
body.zh:
标志是一个使用符号的许可，发放前要评估制造厂的质量体系和产品对标准的符合性。它「自愿」，是指多数紧固件品类并不由法律强制；它又「不自愿」，是指招标可能要、渠道可能要、没有它可能丢单。

标志真正证明的是能力和一致性：这家厂能按标准把这个产品做出来，体系管住了日常。它不证明某一批货。带标志的产品照样需要批次材质书才可追溯，带标志的工厂照样可能发错一批。

拿标志要经过申请、送样检测、生产现场评估、以及后续监督。对从海外工厂采购的进口商来说，这是工厂的决定而不是采购的决定：要几个月、要接受审核，不是一张订单能变出来的。

这就给了买方一个清楚的问题：这项工程要的是标志，还是要的是「符合标准＋批次文件」？要标志，供应商名单立刻收窄，价格也反映这一点；要符合性，名单很宽，靠检验方案把活干完。

客户坚持要标志、而供应商没有的时候，诚实的答案是直说，然后提出替代证据——批次材质书、试验报告、第三方装船前检验——而不是暗示一个并不存在的认证。到了港口拿不出来的「有认证」，比一开始就没有更糟。

body.en:
Testing in this market divides into what the factory does routinely, what an independent laboratory does for a sample, and what a buyer can do at the yard. The factory's routine testing produces the batch records: material properties, hardness, and the dimensional checks it performs per lot. Those records are the base layer, and they should travel with the goods.

Independent laboratory testing is for the questions the factory's own records cannot settle: a type test against a named standard, an alloy verification, a coating assessment, a mechanical test on a sample drawn by the buyer. It is bought per test, it takes time, and it is worth buying once for a new product rather than on every order.

Witnessing is the third layer: a buyer or a nominated third party attends the pre-shipment inspection, watches the sample being drawn and the measurements being made, and signs the record. This is the layer that converts a supplier's statement into the buyer's evidence, and it is what a serious South African importer uses for the first shipment of a new source.

The documents that travel are the same in every direction: invoice, packing list, bill of lading, certificate of origin, the material certificate for the batch, and the test reports that the specification requires. Which of these the destination's authorities will ask for is a customs question; which the customer will ask for is a contract question; the two are not the same list.

A buyer should decide, before the order, which documents are conditions of payment rather than conditions of delivery. A document required for payment gets produced; a document requested after arrival is a negotiation.

这个市场上的「检测」分三层：工厂的例行检测、独立实验室对样品的检测、以及买方在货场能做的检查。工厂例行检测产出批次记录——材料性能、硬度、按批做的尺寸检查。这一层是底子，应当随货走。

独立实验室检测，用来回答工厂自己的记录回答不了的问题：按指定标准做型式试验、合金确认、镀层评估、对买方自抽样品做力学试验。按项买、要时间，值得为新产品买一次，而不是每张订单都买。

见证是第三层：买方或指定的第三方到场参加装船前检验，看着样品怎么抽、数据怎么测，并在记录上签字。这一层把供应商的「陈述」变成买方的「证据」，认真的南非进口商在新来源的第一票上都会用。

随货走的文件，方向不同但清单相似：发票、箱单、提单、产地证、批次材质书，以及规格要求的试验报告。目的国官方要哪些，是海关问题；客户要哪些，是合同问题——这两张清单不是同一张。

买方应该在订货前就分开：哪些文件是付款条件，哪些只是交付条件。作为付款条件的文件一定会被做出来；到港之后才要的文件，谈的是另一回事。

body.en:
Most import problems in this category are not product problems; they are documentation and expectation problems, and they repeat. The first is a certificate that does not match the goods: a batch certificate for a different heat, a test report for a different size, a coating certificate for a different class. This is found at the port, and it is resolved by correspondence, which is the slowest possible way.

The second is a claim of conformity that cannot be evidenced. A supplier states that the product meets a national standard and cannot produce the test report behind the statement; the buyer has bought a claim rather than a product. The fix is to make the evidence a condition of the order rather than a request after it.

The third is a specification written in the wrong vocabulary: a tender requires a designation the supplier does not recognise, and the offer responds with an international equivalent without confirming that it is accepted. The goods arrive compliant with something, and not with what was asked.

The fourth is packaging and marking that do not survive the route: cartons that break, marks that rub off, a packing list that does not match the cartons. At the port, an unmarked carton is an unidentified carton, and identification is the first thing an inspector needs.

Each of these has the same remedy: the requirement is written down before the order, the evidence is made a condition of the order, and the first shipment of a new source is witnessed. None of this is expensive; all of it is cheaper than a container sitting at a terminal while three parties exchange emails.
body.zh:
这个品类里的进口问题，多数不是产品问题，而是文件和预期问题，而且会重复发生。第一种是文件和货对不上：炉号不符的材质书、尺寸不符的试验报告、等级不符的镀层证书。这在港口被发现，然后靠来回发邮件解决——那是最慢的解决方式。

第二种是拿不出证据的「符合性声明」。供应商说产品符合某国家标准，却拿不出这句话背后的试验报告；买方买到的是一句声明，不是一件产品。修法是把证据变成订单条件，而不是到货后的请求。

第三种是规格写错了语汇：招标要求一个供应商不认识的牌号，报价回了一个国际等效型号，却没确认对方接受。货到了，符合某个东西，但不符合要的那个东西。

第四种是包装与标记撑不住这条航线：箱子破了、标记磨掉了、箱单和箱子对不上。在港口，没有标记的箱子就是身份不明的箱子，而身份识别是检查员要做的第一件事。

这四种都有同一个解法：要求在订货前写下来，证据变成订单条件，新来源的第一票做见证。这些都不贵；都比一个集装箱停在码头、三方来回发邮件便宜。

body.en:
South African buyers ask a small set of questions, and the answers are usually about which requirement is actually being invoked.

The most common is whether a product must carry the mark to be sold. For most fastener categories the answer is that conformity to the standard is what matters, and the mark is required when a customer or a tender says so. The second is whether an international standard is acceptable; it usually is, provided the offer names it and the documents reference it, and provided the customer's specification does not name a national edition instead.

The third is how to verify a claim without a laboratory. The answer is a witnessed pre-shipment inspection with a sample drawn and measured in front of the witness, plus the batch records — which is cheaper than a laboratory programme and more convincing than a certificate alone.

The fourth is what happens if the documents are incomplete on arrival. The practical answer is that the goods are held, the clock runs, and the cost lands on the importer; which is why the document list belongs in the purchase order rather than in the correspondence.

See frequently asked questions below.
